title: It was ok!
text: It was ok!. I purchased two of these and the light control button on one of the diffusers did not work. I thank God it came with a remote or else it would have been returned.

product_metadata.title: UMTEC Essential Oil Diffuser for Baby, 500ml Quiet Humidifier for Bedroom Kids with Remote Control & Timer, 7 Color Led Lights Aroma Diffuser
features: This aroma diffuser has 4 misting modes: continuous, 10 seconds(work 10 sec and pauses 10 sec), 2 hours, 4 hours.
This baby humidifier work with less than 34 dB noise, perfect for your bedroom to have a disturbance-free sleep at night.

This cute humidifier will auto shut-off if the water runs out. The led light will not turn off if there is water in tank even if the setting time is running out and led light will only turn off if there is no water.
This aromatherapy diffusers has 6 soothing colors. By default, the led light will change into an automatic colorful cycle mode, certainly you can set the light to off or one color.
The scent diffuser is easy to use and clean. With the remote, you convenient to turn on/off the light and mist when the led defuser is away from you.
